questions.question: Which of the following is a singleton set?
options: $\{x : x \text{ is an even prime number}\}$
questions.finalAnswer: (a) $\{x : x \text{ is an even prime number}\}$
solutionSteps: Even prime number is 2. So set is $\{2\}$, which is a singleton set.
$\{x : x^2 = 4, x \text{ is odd}\}$ is empty.

Case Study: In a group of 50 students, the number of students studying French, English, Sanskrit were found to be as follows: French = 17, English = 13, Sanskrit = 15, French and English = 9, English and Sanskrit = 4, French and Sanskrit = 5, English, French and Sanskrit = 3. Find:
(i) Number of students studying only French.
(ii) Number of students studying exactly one language.
(iii) Number of students studying at least one of the languages.
solutionSteps: (i) Only F = $n(F) - n(F \cap E) - n(F \cap S) + n(F \cap E \cap S) = 17 - 9 - 5 + 3 = 6$.
